meta.name: qwen-image-2-pro
meta.description: Generate images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro via inference.sh CLI. Professional text rendering, fine-grained realism, enhanced semantic adherence. Ideal for posters, banners, and text-heavy designs. Triggers: qwen image pro, qwen-image-pro, qwen 2 pro, alibaba image pro, dashscope pro, professional text rendering

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用阿里通义万相专业版生成高质量图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要专业级文字渲染和写实图片生成
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional text rendering and realistic image generation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行调用阿里云 Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro 模型生成图片，擅长在图片中渲染清晰文字，适合制作海报、横幅等文字密集的设计。
howto.when: 当你提到“qwen image pro”、“qwen-image-pro”、“qwen 2 pro”等关键词，或要求生成带专业文字渲染的图片时触发。

say.text: 生成一张海报，标题“欢迎光临”用粗体蓝色字。
say.note: Claude 会调用模型生成图片。

say.text: 制作一个夏季促销横幅，文字“SUMMER SALE”白色渐变背景。
say.note: Claude 会生成营销横幅图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images using Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro via CLI, with professional text rendering for posters, banners, and text-heavy designs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "qwen image pro", "qwen-image-pro", "qwen 2 pro", or ask for images with professional text rendering.

say_en.text: Generate a poster with title "Welcome" in bold blue text.
say_en.note: Claude will call the model to generate an image.

say_en.text: Create a summer sale banner with text "SUMMER SALE" on gradient background.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a marketing banner image.
